trigger: Name mismatch between Aadhaar and other documents
action: Submit a name correction request via the UIDAI Self-Service Update Portal (ssup.uidai.gov.in) or visit the nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra with valid supporting proof of identity.
requiredDocuments: PAN Card (if name is consistent across other documents)

trigger: DOB mismatch, conflict, or incomplete date on Aadhaar
action: DOB correction in Aadhaar is permitted only once in a lifetime. Submit the correction at an Aadhaar Seva Kendra with original proof of date of birth. The biometric exception procedure may apply if no valid proof exists.
requiredDocuments: Original Birth Certificate issued by local government
Passport (if DOB differs from other records)

trigger: Gender mismatch or update request on Aadhaar
action: Gender correction in Aadhaar can be done at an Aadhaar Seva Kendra. Self-declaration is generally accepted for transgender and third-gender individuals; a gazette notification or medical certificate may be required for other corrections.

trigger: Address mismatch or update required on Aadhaar
action: Address can be updated online via the UIDAI Self-Service Update Portal or at an Aadhaar Seva Kendra using a valid proof of address document.
requiredDocuments: Utility bill (electricity, water, gas — not older than 3 months)

trigger: Name mismatch between PAN and other documents
action: Submit a PAN correction application via the NSDL or UTIITSL portal (online) or in person at a PAN service centre. Use Form 49A for a new PAN or the correction/change form for an existing PAN.
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card (if name is consistent on Aadhaar)
Birth Certificate (if name needs to match birth records)
sourceTitle: PAN Form 49A — Income Tax Department / Protean

action: Submit a PAN correction/update request online via the NSDL or UTIITSL portal with documentary proof of date of birth. Processing typically takes 15–20 working days.
requiredDocuments: School Leaving Certificate / Marksheet (for DOB verification)

action: Submit a PAN correction request with supporting documents showing the correct father's/mother's name. This typically requires birth certificate or gazette notification.
requiredDocuments: Gazette notification (if names were officially changed)

action: Submit a PAN correction application with documentary proof of gender. For transgender individuals, a self-declaration may suffice.

File a correction application with the concerned local Registrar of Births and Deaths office. Distinguish between a clerical error (simpler correction) and a substantive change (requires affidavit and may require court order under Section 15 of the Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969).
requiredDocuments: Affidavit from First Class Magistrate (for substantive changes)
sourceTitle: Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969 — Sections 13, 14, 15 (2023 Amendment)

trigger: DOB mismatch or incomplete date on Birth Certificate
action: DOB corrections on a birth certificate are legally sensitive. Clerical corrections can be made at the Registrar's office with supporting hospital records. Substantive changes require a court order. Delayed registrations follow a different (longer) process. Contact your state's RBD service portal.
requiredDocuments: Affidavit (for corrections after 1 year of registration)
Court order (for substantive changes to DOB)
sourceTitle: Civil Registration System — Registrar General of India

trigger: Parent name mismatch on Birth Certificate
action: Corrections to parent names on a birth certificate require strong documentary evidence. File with the local Registrar. A gazette notification or court order may be required for substantive changes.
sourceTitle: Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969 — Section 13

trigger: Child name not recorded or mismatched on Birth Certificate
action: If the child's name was not entered at the time of registration, a 'name inclusion' can be done within one year of birth at the Registrar's office. After one year, a correction procedure applies.
requiredDocuments: School admission record showing the name
Parent's affidavit for the intended name
sourceTitle: Civil Registration System — Name Inclusion Procedure

trigger: Name mismatch on School Leaving Certificate / TC
action: Contact the issuing school's principal or the relevant State Board of Secondary Education. Provide documentary proof of the correct name. An affidavit and gazette notification are typically required for name changes. Corrections are processed through the school and forwarded to the Board.
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card (as proof of correct name)
Gazette notification (if name was officially changed)
sourceTitle: Maharashtra State Board — TC / SLC Correction Procedure

trigger: DOB mismatch on School Leaving Certificate
action: DOB corrections on School Leaving Certificates are legally sensitive. Contact the issuing school and relevant state board. A court-certified birth certificate or court order is typically required. Additional documentation may be required depending on the issuing authority.
requiredDocuments: Hospital records (if birth certificate is unavailable)
sourceTitle: Maharashtra State Board — DOB Correction Procedure

action: Contact the relevant State Board of Secondary/Higher Secondary Education for a marksheet name correction. The process typically requires an affidavit, gazette notification, and supporting identity documents. Processing times vary by board.
sourceTitle: Maharashtra State Board — Marksheet Correction Procedure

trigger: No consensus reached — tied or insufficient evidence
action: Verify original records with the issuing authority for each conflicting document. Do not rely on any single document or this system's analysis as legal proof. Consult the relevant issuing authority directly.

trigger: Year-only DOB (declared/approximate) vs full DOB — incomplete date conflict
action: Verify the exact date of birth with the original issuing authority. UIDAI recognises 'declared/approximate DOB' when valid proof was unavailable at enrolment. Obtain original birth or hospital records before seeking any correction.
requiredDocuments: Original Birth Certificate or hospital birth record
Aadhaar Seva Kendra appointment (for UIDAI declared DOB correction)
